name: Peñuelas (Puerto Rico, United States)
description: Canary yellow field for the sun with a purple cross extending to the edges, for Christianity and the spiritual life.
history: Peñuelas is a town and municipality in Puerto Rico located in the Peñuelas Valley on the southern coast of the island, south of Adjuntas, east of Guayanilla, west of Ponce and north of the Caribbean Sea. The flag was adopted in 1974 (designed by the Institute of Puerto Rican Culture in 1974, according to Flags of the World).
